quests.instruction: Tempura shrimp and potato chips are cooked in a pot of hot oil. What's the cooking word?
quests.hint: This method is famous for making food extra crispy and golden.
quests.explanation: Correct! Tempura shrimp and potato chips are both cooked in a pot of hot oil!
quests.funFact: Frying an egg in a pan takes only a few minutes.

quests.instruction: Garlic cloves are cut into tiny pieces before going into a pan. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This step is usually the first one after peeling a vegetable.
quests.explanation: Super! Garlic cloves are cut into tiny pieces before cooking, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? chopping uses a sharp knife to cut food into small, bite-sized pieces.

quests.instruction: Cookies and bread cook slowly inside a hot oven. What cooking word describes this?
quests.hint: This cooking method uses dry heat all around the food.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Cookies and bread both cook using dry heat inside an oven, which is what this word means!
quests.funFact: You can also bake vegetables like potatoes to make them soft and sweet.

quests.instruction: A loaf of bread is cut into thin, even pieces before making toast. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This word means cutting something into thin, flat pieces.
quests.explanation: You found it! A loaf of bread is cut into thin, flat pieces, which is exactly what this word means!
quests.funFact: Slicing an apple horizontally reveals a beautiful star shape inside.

quests.instruction: Salad greens and dressing are tossed together in a big bowl. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This is what you do to combine two or more foods into one.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Salad greens and dressing are tossed and combined together into one dish!
quests.funFact: Mixing blue and yellow frosting will create green frosting.

quests.instruction: An egg and a chicken cutlet are cooked in a hot, oiled pan. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This cooking method often needs a splash of oil or butter first.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! An egg and a chicken cutlet are both cooked in a hot, oiled pan!
quests.funFact: Fried foods are delicious but should be eaten as a special treat.

quests.instruction: A pie and a tray of biscuits are cooked slowly inside a hot oven. What word fits?
quests.hint: You usually need a preheated oven and a timer for this cooking method.
quests.explanation: Terrific! A pie and biscuits are both cooked slowly inside a preheated oven!
quests.funFact: Did you know? baking uses dry heat, usually in an oven, to cook food slowly.

quests.instruction: Dumplings and beets are cooked in a pot of rapidly bubbling water. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This cooking method makes the biggest, fastest bubbles of all.
quests.explanation: Yes! Dumplings and beets are both cooked in a pot of rapidly bubbling water!
quests.funFact: A hard-boiled egg is cooked entirely in boiling water.

quests.instruction: Cookie dough is stirred together until every ingredient is combined. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This step usually happens in a bowl, using a spoon or an electric beater.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cookie dough is stirred until every ingredient is combined into one, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: A blender is a machine that mixes ingredients extremely fast.

quests.instruction: Muffin batter is stirred together with a spoon until it's smooth. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word is the opposite of keeping every ingredient separate.
quests.explanation: Great job! Muffin batter is stirred together with a spoon until smooth, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? mixing combines different ingredients together until they are one.

quests.instruction: A turkey is cooked slowly in the oven for a holiday feast. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This method often fills the whole kitchen with a rich, savory smell.
quests.explanation: You got it! A turkey is cooked slowly in the oven, filling the kitchen with a rich smell, which is this word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? roasting uses high heat in an oven to brown the outside of food.

quests.instruction: A hard-boiled egg has its shell removed before it's eaten. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This step usually starts with a light tap to crack the surface.
quests.explanation: Well done! A hard-boiled egg has its shell removed before eating, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: You have to peel a banana before you can eat the soft fruit inside.

quests.instruction: The skin is pulled off a banana before it's eaten. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This word means removing the outer skin of a fruit or vegetable.
quests.explanation: Correct! The skin of a banana is pulled off before eating, which is exactly what this word means!
quests.funFact: The peel of many fruits actually contains the highest amount of vitamins.

quests.instruction: A pancake and a grilled cheese are cooked in a hot, buttered pan. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word means cooking directly in oil or butter over heat.
quests.explanation: Super! A pancake and a grilled cheese are both cooked directly in a buttered pan over heat!
quests.funFact: Did you know? frying cooks food quickly in very hot oil or butter.

quests.instruction: Dumplings are cooked in a basket set above a pot of boiling water. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This method never lets the food actually touch the water.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Dumplings are cooked in a basket above boiling water, never touching it, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? steaming cooks food using the hot vapor of boiling water.

quests.instruction: Steak and bell peppers are cooked directly over hot flames. What's the word?
quests.hint: This method leaves crispy char marks in neat lines.
quests.explanation: You found it! Steak and bell peppers are both cooked directly over hot flames, leaving crispy char marks!
quests.funFact: Did you know? grilling cooks food quickly over an open flame or hot coals.

quests.instruction: A whole chicken is cooked slowly in the oven until its skin turns golden. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This method uses the dry heat of an oven, often for a big piece of meat.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! A whole chicken is cooked slowly in an oven's dry heat until golden, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? roasted vegetables get incredibly sweet and crispy on the edges.

quests.instruction: The skin is taken off a potato before it's mashed. Which word fits?
quests.hint: A small kitchen tool with a blade is often used for this step.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! The skin of a potato is taken off before mashing, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? peeling removes the tough outer skin from fruits and vegetables.

quests.instruction: Pasta and eggs are cooked in water that's bubbling hard and fast. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This method uses water at its hottest, most bubbly point.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Pasta and eggs are both cooked in water at its hottest, most bubbly point!
quests.funFact: Did you know? boiling means heating water until it bubbles rapidly at 212 degrees.

quests.instruction: Flour, eggs, and sugar are stirred together to make cake batter. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This word means combining ingredients together with a spoon or a whisk.
quests.explanation: Yes! Flour, eggs, and sugar are stirred and combined together with a spoon, which is what this word means!
quests.funFact: Did you know? you use a spoon or a whisk to mix batter for pancakes.

quests.instruction: A block of cheese is cut into thin flat pieces for a sandwich. What's the word?
quests.hint: This step usually comes right before layering food onto bread.
quests.explanation: That's right! A block of cheese is cut into thin flat pieces for a sandwich, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: A pizza cutter uses a rolling wheel to slice perfectly straight lines.

quests.instruction: An orange's thick skin is removed before eating the juicy segments inside. What's the word?
quests.hint: This step often happens with your fingers, no tool needed.
quests.explanation: Great job! An orange's thick skin is removed before eating, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a potato peeler makes it very fast to take the skin off a potato.

quests.instruction: Potatoes and corn on the cob are cooked in fast-bubbling water. What word fits?
quests.hint: You'll see big bubbles rising quickly to the top of the pot.
quests.explanation: You got it! Potatoes and corn are both cooked in water with big bubbles rising quickly!
quests.funFact: Did you know? pasta and rice must be boiled in water to make them soft.

quests.instruction: Carrots are cut into small bite-sized pieces for a stew. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This step usually happens on a cutting board with a knife.
quests.explanation: Well done! Carrots are cut into small bite-sized pieces on a cutting board, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? chefs learn to chop vegetables incredibly fast to save time.

quests.instruction: A cucumber is cut into thin, round pieces for a salad. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This step turns one long vegetable into many thin, flat pieces.
quests.explanation: Correct! A cucumber is cut into thin, round pieces for a salad, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? slicing means cutting food into thin, flat pieces.

quests.instruction: Carrots turn tender using hot rising vapor in a covered pot. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This method is a healthy way to cook vegetables without extra oil or butter.
quests.explanation: Super! Carrots turn tender using hot rising vapor in a covered pot, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it is one of the healthiest ways to cook vegetables because it traps vitamins inside.

quests.instruction: Bacon and French fries are cooked quickly in a pan of hot oil. What's this cooking word?
quests.hint: This method makes a sizzling sound in a hot pan.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Bacon and french fries are both cooked quickly in a pan of hot oil, which sizzles!
quests.funFact: Did you know? french fries get their crispy texture from being deep-fried.

quests.instruction: Corn and juicy burgers get their char marks from this outdoor cooking method. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes cooking with direct heat from below, usually outside.
quests.explanation: You found it! Corn and juicy burgers both get their char marks from cooking with direct heat below!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it gives food a smoky flavor and leaves dark grill marks.

quests.instruction: A birthday cake is cut into thin, even wedges to share with guests. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This is the very last step before everyone gets their own piece.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! A birthday cake is cut into thin, even wedges to share, which is this cooking word!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a loaf of bread is sliced so it can be used for sandwiches.

quests.instruction: A loaf of sourdough and a tray of scones are cooked this way. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This cooking word means using the dry heat of an oven, not a stovetop.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Sourdough and scones are both cooked using the dry heat of an oven!
quests.funFact: Did you know? bread, cakes, and cookies are all made by baking dough or batter.
